## Thinking Path

- What project context and constraints led to this change?
- Why is this the smallest appropriate implementation?

## What Changed

- Describe concrete behavior, contract, and documentation changes.

## Verification

- List exact commands and manual checks reviewers can repeat.

## Risks

- Describe failure modes, compatibility concerns, and rollback notes.

## Model Used

- Provider, exact model ID, context window, and relevant capabilities; or `None — human-authored`.

## Checklist

- [ ] Scope matches the linked issue and approved architecture.
- [ ] Tests, vet, and build pass.
- [ ] Configuration and documentation are synchronized.
- [ ] No secrets or sensitive user data are included.
- [ ] Review is requested from the required owner.
